description: Routes that take a learner/student id and use the service-role client WITHOUT calling a recognised ownership check (scripts/security/route-auth-rules.mjs OWNERSHIP_GUARD_CALLS). Each was read and its caller-to-learner authorization recorded here (security audit 2026-10-30, F-11). 'via' names the function that authorizes — the gate fails if the route stops calling it — or 'inline' for an explicit owner-scoped query/comparison in the route itself. A new route that matches the rule fails CI until it either calls a recognised check or is reviewed and added here. This is a manual-review requirement, not a proof: the gate cannot verify inline logic.

admin/pilot/add.reason: Platform-admin surface by design: lib/auth/isAdmin.ts (hardcoded founder email or profiles.role = 'admin'; clients cannot set role — trg_guard_profile_role).

assessments/history.reason: Loads only students with user_id = caller, then reads assessments .in() that owned set; the optional student_id filter narrows within it.

career/clinic-report.reason: Requires a students row with id = studentId AND user_id = caller (read through the caller's own session client) before any service-role read; 403 otherwise.

career/intelligence-report.reason: Reads the student and requires student.user_id or student.parent_user_id to equal the caller before any report work; 403 otherwise.

dashboard/stats.reason: Every query is scoped to the caller (user_id / learner_id = user.id, the caller's own students, the caller's own teacher row).

formative/signal.reason: Requires teacher_classes.teacher_id = caller's teacher for the class, then rejects any submitted student not on that class's roster.

groups/challenge.reason: Acts only as the caller's own student (students.user_id = caller) and their own membership row in the group.

groups/create.reason: Creates a group for the caller's own student (students.user_id = caller) only.

groups/join.reason: Joins as the caller's own student (students.user_id = caller) only.

holiday/publish.reason: Class path requires teacher_classes.teacher_id = caller's teacher; per-student path publishes only plans whose teacher_id is the caller's teacher (learner-intelligence repository publishHolidayPlans).

parent/alerts.reason: Reads alerts only for roster rows with class_students.parent_id = caller. That link is now set only by email-matched invite redemption (lib/classes/redeemClassInvite.ts, F-12).

parent/compass-activity.reason: repos.compass.findOwnedStudents(caller) — the caller's own and parent-linked students — then reads sessions .in() that set only.

parent/link-student.reason: Authority is a single-use, expiring student_invites token bound to this student_id; refuses a student already linked to a different parent.

reports/clinic/[reportId]/url.reason: Explicit branches before signing: the learner's owner, a parent linked via class_students.parent_id, the report's teacher, or a platform admin; 403 otherwise.

share/generate.reason: Requires a students row with id = studentId AND user_id = caller before creating a share link.

students/[studentId].reason: DELETE requires student.user_id = caller; PATCH (unlink) requires student.parent_user_id = caller and a teacher-managed record.

teacher/assessments/[assessmentId]/marks.reason: GET and POST both load the assessment by (assessmentId, caller's teacher id) — 404 otherwise — and resolve learners only from that assessment's own class roster.

teacher/assignments/[id]/mark.reason: Requires assignments.teacher_id = caller's teacher; the mark target must be a submission of that assignment (lib/assignments/markSubmission.ts).

teacher/assignments/[id].reason: GET allows only the assignment's creator or the current teaching-tenure holder of its class; PATCH updates only where teacher_id = caller's teacher.

teacher/students/[studentId]/timeline.reason: Requires a class_students row for the learner joined to teacher_classes.teacher_id = caller's teacher before reading the timeline.
